summary: Configured node1 to back up `/srv/inventory/data` from node2 nightly at 02:00. Archives are stored under `/var/backups/inventory` with dated filenames and seven-day retention. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created the source and destination directories with appropriate permissions.
Configured a node-generated SSH key restricted to the required tar operation.
Installed an atomic, locked backup script and enabled the cron schedule.
Verified cross-node transfer using matching SHA-256 checksums.
Confirmed archives older than seven days are deleted while six-day-old archives remain.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backup from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Shows the 02:00 cron schedule, successful checksum-matched transfer, restricted SSH pull, valid dated archive, and active/enabled crond.
An eight-day-old archive was pruned while a six-day-old archive was retained; the installed script uses `-mtime +6`.
Captures the healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, boot ID change, recovered cron service, persisted schedule, and successful post-restart backup.
Captures the healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, boot ID change, recovered SSH/source/key state, and successful backup after node2 restarted.
